comment: sptd mode only. flask-api runs as a measured CPython script target (python-script.json: the real interpreter /usr/local/bin/python3.11 with -I -B, python and python3 as aliases). The command is the absolute script /app/app.py; the image's own command is not one of the two forms a script contract accepts. The Flask app needs site-packages, so -S is not set. The demo's manifests and the sgx/cvm modes are unchanged.
